title: Sitiari za Tabia (Theme 10: Kukabiliana na ugaidi)
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 6 Kiswahili; not yet checked by a native Kiswahili teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child calls a person the animal that stands for the trait (Yeye ni simba = brave), without kama, and knows it is not literal.
contexts: fighting terrorism: a brave police officer

board.do: Wait for the child to answer before saying anything.
The child explains the sitiari and writes one for a kind person.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Kamau hufanya kazi kutwa nzima bila kuchoka. Kamau ni ___." Kwa nini "kobe" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Kila mnyama hutumika kuonyesha tabia: nyuki (bidii), simba (ujasiri), kobe (polepole), kinyonga (kubadilika), mbweha (ujanja), tausi (kujionyesha).

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Chagua sentensi iliyo sitiari." Kwa nini "Mwalimu ni kama simba." si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Tashbihi hulinganisha kwa kutumia "kama". Sitiari husema moja ni lingine bila "kama".

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Chagua sentensi iliyo sitiari." Kwa nini "Mwalimu ana simba." si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Sitiari haisemi mtu ana mnyama. Inasema mtu ni mnyama kwa tabia yake.

misconceptions.ask: Katika hadithi, fisi ana tabia gani?
misconceptions.repair: Fisi huwakilisha ulafi; njiwa huwakilisha upole.

checks.question: Badilisha tashbihi kuwa sitiari: "Ni mpole kama njiwa."
"Mwalimu wetu ni simba" maana yake ni?
